rationale: Inherited recovery limits unchanged. Transport truncation now holds later JPP requests offline until explicit Retry, preventing overlapping demands from completing the interrupted cache prefix before the retry measurement. Seven image switches cycle the actual catalogue instead of requiring nine parents. Actual representation/GPU eviction remains mandatory; unsupported small-catalogue pressure remains a failed result, never waived.
